scores.rationale: The candidate implements the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`, and `ListSessionsMessage`/`SessionListMessage`/`SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`/`ConversationListMessage`/`ConversationSummary`/`ConversationCursor`). Furthermore, `createMessageHandler` makes `sessionStore` a required second parameter instead of optional, which breaks existing 1-arg callers (`messageHandler.test.ts`), and the error handler logs `(error as Error).message` without `sessionId` despite the ticket and security requirements prohibiting logging raw store messages and requiring `sessionId`. The candidate also omits `StoreCannotList`, startup/connection warnings when `resume` is off, updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and tests for non-blocking concurrent streaming or end-to-end session resumption.
